## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** The added `inputMethodHints` do not change the hints an input method receives from any of the three password fields, so this PR does not address the plaintext preedit described in #13002. No regression was found.

### Password echo mode overrides the explicit hints

Qt Quick answers the input method's `ImHints` query with `QQuickTextInputPrivate::effectiveInputMethodHints()`, not with the raw QML property. For `TextInput.Password` that function already adds `ImhSensitiveData`, `ImhNoPredictiveText` and `ImhNoAutoUppercase`. On Qt 6.11 it also clears `ImhHiddenText` in Password mode, even when the QML property sets it ([qquicktextinput.cpp v6.11.2, L1197-L1208](https://github.com/qt/qtdeclarative/blob/v6.11.2/src/quick/items/qquicktextinput.cpp#L1197-L1208), [L2049-L2056](https://github.com/qt/qtdeclarative/blob/v6.11.2/src/quick/items/qquicktextinput.cpp#L2049-L2056)). `QQuickTextField` inherits this from `QQuickTextInput`, so `Ui.TextField` behaves the same way.

```text
Effective ImHints reported to the input method
(lock field, Ui.TextField in password mode, masked polkit field)

Qt              base    head (declares 0x43)   source of value
6.11.2 (Arch)   0x46    0x46                   measured in an offscreen probe
6.10.2          0x47    0x47                   read from source

0x01 HiddenText   0x02 SensitiveData   0x04 NoAutoUppercase   0x40 NoPredictiveText
```

Control: a Normal-echo field with the same declared hints reported `0x43`, so the probe does see explicit hints when the echo mode leaves them alone.

On Omarchy's default input path (`QT_IM_MODULE=fcitx`), fcitx5-qt maps only `ImhHiddenText` to fcitx5's `Password` capability ([qfcitxplatforminputcontext.cpp 5.1.16, L421-L422](https://github.com/fcitx/fcitx5-qt/blob/5.1.16/qt5/platforminputcontext/qfcitxplatforminputcontext.cpp#L421-L422)). fcitx5 5.1.23 masks preedit and falls back to the keyboard layout only for that capability ([instance.cpp L1739-L1761](https://github.com/fcitx/fcitx5/blob/5.1.23/src/lib/fcitx/instance.cpp#L1739-L1761), [L2373-L2401](https://github.com/fcitx/fcitx5/blob/5.1.23/src/lib/fcitx/instance.cpp#L2373-L2401)). On the Wayland text-input-v3 fallback, `0x46` becomes `SENSITIVE_DATA` with a normal content purpose. Neither path sees a change between base and head.

**Impact:** The lock screen, Wi-Fi passphrase and masked polkit fields send the input method the same hints as before. The new code comments say the hints make password mode opt out of composition, and the description says Qt suppresses preedit with these flags. Qt does neither. Preedit text is inserted unmasked, and echo mode masks only committed text ([L3037-L3063](https://github.com/qt/qtdeclarative/blob/v6.11.2/src/quick/items/qquicktextinput.cpp#L3037-L3063), [L3656-L3665](https://github.com/qt/qtdeclarative/blob/v6.11.2/src/quick/items/qquicktextinput.cpp#L3656-L3665)). The comments would point future readers to a protection that does not operate.

**Suggested change:** Drop the redundant bindings and their comments, or replace them with a change checked against the effective `ImHints` value and a live composing input method.

**Unverified lead:** On Qt 6.11.2, none of these fields gets fcitx5's `Password` capability, in base or head. A composing engine can therefore stay active on them and send unmasked preedit. That is a plausible cause of #12727 and #13002, but it was not reproduced. A `TextInput.NoEcho` field keeps `HiddenText` (the probe reported `0x47`), so a NoEcho field with a separately drawn mask is one possible direction. It is untested.

**Optional test improvement:** The new test checks declaration text, so it passes whether or not Qt honors the hints. Its fixed 2000-character slice in `PolkitAgent.qml` also reaches the sibling placeholder `Text` element. With the polkit hint line moved into that `Text`, which has no `inputMethodHints` property, all 17 checks still passed. If a source test stays, bound each match to the input's own block.

**Verified:** The `passwordCharacter` edit is behavior-neutral, because the literal and `"●"` are the same U+25CF character. The polkit field switches echo mode and hints together from the same `responseVisible` value. The three edited fields are the only password inputs under `shell/`.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review of the pinned head and base, plus the Qt, fcitx5-qt and fcitx5 sources linked above at the versions Arch currently ships, with Qt 6.10.2 for comparison. An isolated offscreen probe on Qt 6.11.2 queried `ImHints` from QML copies of the three fields' input-related properties, not from the full Omarchy components. The new test's JavaScript ran unmodified on head, on base and on one mutation, in Qt's JavaScript engine instead of Node. No lock screen, polkit prompt or input method session was run, so the on-screen preedit was not observed.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, independent Opus 5.5 Xhigh and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
